changelog: Version 3.1.1 – Pack fixes & duel prompt Also feel free to join the Discord for this mod's community here - https://discord.gg/rEVYZEbnMc Fixed: Premium Pack & Hidden Arsenal pull rates Sets where every card is Super Rare or better (Premium Pack, Premium Pack 2 and Hidden Arsenal 1–5) had broken odds. Six of the seven cards in every pack came from the same few Super Rares, and a Secret Rare turned up only about once every 31 packs. Finishing Premium Pack took around 1,450 packs. Every pack of these sets now has one guaranteed Secret Rare in the last slot, with every Secret Rare equally likely. Super Rares still fill the other slots. Rough number of packs to complete a set now: Premium Pack ~45, Premium Pack 2 ~70, Hidden Arsenal 1–5 ~50–70 each. Thanks to the player who reported this! New: "Press E to duel" prompt Looking at a play table now shows a Press [E] to duel prompt, so you know dueling is there. It hides during duels and while menus are open, and it shows your own key if you've changed it. Turn it off with ShowPrompt = false under [Controls] in BepInEx\config\dan.ygodueltable.cfg. Other No other set has changed. All other packs, prices and unlock levels are exactly as in 3.0.0. Behind the scenes: the mod can now support special cards with their own artwork, odds and price, including "1 of 1" cards that can only ever be pulled once per save. None are in this version but soon to come. Updating Delete your old Dan's YuGiOh Expansion folder and install the new version. Your collection and saves are untouched. The new odds apply to packs opened after updating. If you play online duels, both players should update.
